material_layout.status: ENGINEERED MATERIAL SUBSTITUTION; user explicitly selected OUTSIDE 200x150x50mm. Not the original manufacturer dieline.
engineering_changes: Base scores moved to preserve 200x150 external body, with surface-hinge thickness allowance.
Back wall/front wall and side roll heights shortened to place lid top at 50mm.
Two slot notches widened inward to roll width + thickness + 0.25mm clearance.
Front/back/lid corner hinges staggered for two 1.53mm layers and 0.2mm gaps.
Lid and lid side-flap scores resized to fit inside double walls.
Two tongue tails lengthened to 2mm and bend allowance relocated.
Four pre-existing unscored bend approximations are explicitly proposed extra scores in this E-flute derivative; passive properties remain uncalibrated.
Front lid flap retains the source outside-wrap structure; body front recessed by thickness +0.25mm to preserve full150mm outside depth.
50mm outside height includes folded tail material below the base, not only lid-to-base height.
Explicit end/top relief cuts are applied for finite E-flute thickness; no tabs, slots or panels deleted.
material_layout.physical_limits: Rigid, homogeneous effective panels, ideal scored folds. No claim of real crease crush/radius, flute anisotropy, tab durability or proven latch strength.

relief_cuts.note: Physical relief cuts, not contact exclusions: lower corner tops below rolled top, shorten inner/roll ends, shorten lid dust-flap noses and lid corner tops. Net material is recomputed.

geometry_status: ENGINEERED E-FLUTE DERIVATIVE; polygon_pdf_pt are transformed diagram coordinates, not original source anchors. Raw source vectors retained separately.
